subject: National literals
notes: "The separators that delimit the national literal are not included in the value" (cite.py --check 8.3.3.5.4 -> OK, rule 1). CobolLiteral.Decode strips the N/NX prefix and both delimiters (Body[1..^1]). Probe p1: FUNCTION LENGTH(N"A""B")=3, LENGTH(N"")=0, VALUE N"Q""R" -> [Q"R ]. The covering test asserts DISPLAY N"AB" -> AB. [editions as adjudicated: COBOL-2002, COBOL-2014, COBOL-2023 (national literals are a COBOL-2002 introduction; absent from COBOL-85, where the construct is rejected COBOL0900 via Constructs.NationalData2002)]
